verdict.rationale: Close's own developer docs list a Bulk Actions API resource (e.g., a bulk_action/email endpoint) and say workflows can be managed with bulk actions, and pricing lists 'Send bulk email', so bulk operations are a first-party capability. The evidence only concretely shows bulk email, so how far bulk operations extend is unproven. missing for 10: documented bulk edit/update/delete operations across leads or contacts, details on query-based item selection and batch size or limits, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Manage workflows with sequences or bulk actions, or send email/SMS programmatically.
